title: PM Internship Scheme 2026: Rs 9,000 Monthly Stipend, 1.1 Lakh Opportunities - How to Apply
author: Ash K.
excerpt: The PM Internship Scheme (PMIS) 2026 offers paid internships with India's top 500 companies. Eligible youth aged 21-24 receive Rs 9,000 per month, a one-time Rs 6,000 grant, insurance cover, and a government-recognized certificate. Registration is open at pminternship.mca.gov.in.
key_stat: Rs 9,000/month stipend | Ages 21-24 | 1.1 lakh internships | Extended till Dec 2026
body: The Government of India's PM Internship Scheme (PMIS) 2026 is actively accepting applications through the official portal pminternship.mca.gov.in. Administered by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, the scheme offers approximately 1.1 lakh internship opportunities with India's top 500 companies across 20+ sectors including IT, banking, manufacturing, healthcare, and energy.

Each selected intern receives a monthly stipend of Rs 9,000 - of which Rs 4,500 comes from the central government through Direct Benefit Transfer and Rs 500 from the company's CSR funds. Additionally, a one-time grant of Rs 6,000 is provided upon joining. Interns are also covered under the Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana and Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana, providing life and accidental insurance cover throughout the internship.

The scheme targets Indian citizens between 21 and 24 years of age. Candidates must not be engaged in full-time employment or regular education at the time of application. Those in their final year of graduation or post-graduation may apply in certain cases. The family income criteria ensure the program reaches youth from economically weaker backgrounds who would otherwise lack access to corporate internship opportunities.

Internship opportunities are available at prominent organizations across the country. Reports indicate openings at companies like Tata Group, Reliance Industries, Mahindra Group, TCS, Larsen & Toubro, and several other leading Indian corporations. The internship duration is 6 to 9 months, and interns spend 50% of their time in hands-on work environments alongside industry professionals.

The selection process is merit-based and fully automated through the PMIS portal. Candidates must complete their profile to 100%, including e-KYC through Aadhaar, personal details, educational qualifications, skills, and bank account information. Companies review candidate profiles and shortlist based on qualifications, skills, and location preferences. Selected candidates receive offer letters through the portal dashboard and must accept within 14 days.

Upon successful completion of the internship, interns receive a PMIS Completion Certificate recognized by the Government of India. This certificate serves as a credible credential on resumes and can open doors to permanent employment. While the scheme does not guarantee a job after completion, many companies have historically offered positions to high-performing interns.

callout.heading: How to register for PM Internship Scheme 2026
callout.content: Visit pminternship.mca.gov.in and click on Youth Registration. Enter your Aadhaar-linked mobile number and verify with OTP. Create a password and log in. Complete your profile with personal details, educational qualifications, skills, and bank account information. Complete e-KYC through Aadhaar verification. Browse internship listings by sector, location, or keyword. You can apply for up to 3 internships at a time. Ensure your bank account is Aadhaar-seeded for receiving the stipend via DBT. The registration is completely free - do not pay anyone for application assistance.

faqs.question: What is the PM Internship Scheme 2026 stipend amount?
faqs.answer: Selected interns receive Rs 9,000 per month for the entire internship duration of 6-9 months. Rs 4,500 comes from the government via DBT and Rs 500 from the company's CSR funds. A one-time joining grant of Rs 6,000 is also provided.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for PM Internship Scheme 2026?
faqs.answer: Indian citizens aged 21-24 years who are not in full-time employment or regular education can apply. The scheme targets youth from economically weaker backgrounds. Final-year graduation or post-graduation students may also be eligible in certain cases.

faqs.question: Which companies participate in PM Internship Scheme?
faqs.answer: India's top 500 companies participate across sectors like IT, banking, manufacturing, healthcare, and energy. Companies include Tata Group, Reliance, Mahindra, TCS, L&T, and many others. Over 34,000 internship opportunities have been posted on the portal.

faqs.question: Does PM Internship Scheme guarantee a job after completion?
faqs.answer: No, the scheme does not guarantee employment after the internship. However, companies may offer positions to high-performing interns. You receive a government-recognized PMIS Completion Certificate that strengthens your resume for future job applications.

faqs.question: Is there any fee to apply for PM Internship Scheme?
faqs.answer: No, the entire registration and application process is completely free. Do not pay any third party or agent for application assistance. Apply only through the official portal pminternship.mca.gov.in.
